response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with 15+ years of development experience and genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, CI/CD infrastructure, device orchestration tools, testing frameworks), but the resume shows no formal people management or team leadership experience, which is a hard requirement for this Level II manager role. The career trajectory is deep IC work rather than management, and mobile-platform experience is limited to a brief stint maintaining iOS/Apple TV apps. This profile fits a Staff Engineer role far better than an Engineering Manager position.
strengths: Extensive developer-tools experience: built test runners (Trial), assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, and device orchestration tooling
15+ years of broad software development across web, mobile, embedded, and high-scale backend systems
Demonstrated mentorship inclination via workshops, courses, and community teaching (Selenium course, code katas, conference talks)
concerns: No formal people management experience — fails the 2-year minimum requirement
No evidence of the 3 years in a designated technical leadership role (roadmaps, org change, performance management)
Mobile-platform experience is shallow and dated (one project ending in 2016)

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure background
